title: Black Bean & Cheese Quesadillas
description: Crisp tortillas folded around mashed black beans, melted cheese and corn — quick and genuinely filling.
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and mashed
Salsa and Greek yogurt to serve
steps: Mix the mashed beans with cumin and corn.
Spread onto half of each tortilla with cheese, fold over, and cook in a dry pan 2-3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and yogurt.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food vegetarian recipe collection

notes: A genuine 15-minute meal — keep canned black beans on hand for nights you need dinner fast.
